notes.title: Just A Demo - Free Demo Release
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40284516/d61ecfb2c45d9ec51b988449449d0a27130f2793.jpg"]



JUST A GUY demo will be available on September 12, 2025!

Just A Guy (JAG) free Demo will be available tomorrow at 14:00 (GMT +2) on Steam.



I've put a lot of work and love into this game, and I'm really looking forward to seeing players from around the world try out the demo and give their feedback.


[previewyoutube="QlKFgsbpG_8;full"][/previewyoutube]


DEMO FEATURES

Online multiplayer mode for 2 players (solo mode possible).

1 large level to explore, filled with activities and secrets to discover.

Try out different vehicles such as cars, planes, helicopters, boats, jet skis, and much more.

Experience a wide range of gameplay abilities such as speed shoes, boxing gloves, balloons, grabbing, climbing, driving, falling, sliding and more.

Estimated time to complete the demo: 2 to 6 hours.

Attention - GAMEPAD only for now.





I hope you enjoy the demo!

Thanks.

David.
